An interpolated verse, which is not healed by Elmsley's conjecture πεῖθέ νιν [persuade him]. For the sense requires something like this: εἴσω φρενῶν ξυνεῖσα δέξεται λόγον [having understood within her mind she will receive the word], as can be gathered from v. 1060.
